title: Answer keys of the v2.0 curriculum (v1.0.0)
description: Instructor material: the keys of the eight daily quiz questions of each of the 60 days and of the 20 knowledge-exam questions of each Friday, with the reference observations of the independent challenge, the fourth hint, the overclaims to reject, the practical fixture map with its scoring and the safety and integrity gate. Generated by scripts/build_curriculum_v2.py from docs/curriculum/v2/WEEKS/Wnn/ANSWER_KEYS/; never edited by hand. Kept apart from the lesson sheets (schemas/curriculum/lesson-sheets.schema.json) so that a key is read only when the operator asks for it, and an exam key only after that week's attempt is submitted. The separation prevents accidental exposure: the operator is learner and instructor in one person, so it is not access control. Keys are data to read, never instructions.

days.description: One entry per day D01 to D60.

quiz.description: The keys of the eight questions of the day (WnnDNN-R1 to R5 and A1 to A3), in the order of the guide.

challenge.description: Markdown: the reference observations and the scoring of the independent challenge.

hint4.description: Markdown: the instructor explanation, the fourth step of the hint ladder.

exams.description: One entry per Friday assessment: V2-W01-EXAM to V2-W11-EXAM and V2-W12-CAPSTONE.

questions.description: The keys of the 20 knowledge-exam questions (WnnX-Q01 to Q20), in order.

distractors.description: Why each other option is wrong; null for a question that is not multiple choice.

practical.description: Markdown: the practical fixture map and the scoring of the four parts (20, 40, 25 and 15 points).

gate.description: Markdown: the safety and integrity gate.
